## Experimental work is routed, not silently promoted

Compiler, IR, execution-field, live gating, tokenization, adaptive indexing,
and physical layout experiments have produced useful mechanisms and
evidence. Their existence does not make each interface a supported general
API. The maturity and limits of each component belong beside its evidence;
the dated [implementation record](current_implementation.qmd) links the
current records.

The [experimental fields note](development/experimental-fields.md) describes
the current narrow `ExecutionField` module. The older compiler- and runtime-
oriented documentation remains accessible below for source/history context;
the current product description and stable package route are in
[architecture](architecture.qmd) and [developer reference](developer_reference.qmd).

## Branch closure and preservation records

The 2026-10-28 branch audit, verified branch closure, and remaining archival
holds are documented in the repository's
[archive disposition](https://github.com/tumlinso/Cellerator/blob/94c534fc794fe8cc3e0434e4a50f379401ddbb3c/planning/coherence/archive-disposition.md),
[branch-closure receipt](https://github.com/tumlinso/Cellerator/blob/94c534fc794fe8cc3e0434e4a50f379401ddbb3c/planning/coherence/branch-closure.json),
and [branch comparison](https://github.com/tumlinso/Cellerator/blob/94c534fc794fe8cc3e0434e4a50f379401ddbb3c/planning/coherence/branches.md).
The disposition record links the preserved bundle and checksum, retained refs,
historical plan-path holds, payload holds, and supported-workflow hold. These
records explain branch preservation and archival boundaries; the source map
still assigns each repository path its own disposition.

## Root research snapshots

The root also retains dated design and operational material. These links pin
the original files to the audited `main` snapshot and preserve their context:
[architecture follow-ups](https://github.com/tumlinso/Cellerator/blob/2f851ddb9719a85064f7140864c614245424f4cc/ARCHITECTURE_FOLLOWUPS.md),
[execution-field investigation](https://github.com/tumlinso/Cellerator/blob/2f851ddb9719a85064f7140864c614245424f4cc/ARCHITECTURE_INVESTIGATION.md),
[optimization evidence](https://github.com/tumlinso/Cellerator/blob/2f851ddb9719a85064f7140864c614245424f4cc/optimization.md),
[planning strategy](https://github.com/tumlinso/Cellerator/blob/2f851ddb9719a85064f7140864c614245424f4cc/planning_strategy.md),
the [out-of-scope migration inventory](https://github.com/tumlinso/Cellerator/blob/2f851ddb9719a85064f7140864c614245424f4cc/out_of_scope_inventory.md),
and [local environment notes](https://github.com/tumlinso/Cellerator/blob/2f851ddb9719a85064f7140864c614245424f4cc/ENVIRONMENT_NOTES.md).
The [custom Torch operation registry](https://github.com/tumlinso/Cellerator/blob/2f851ddb9719a85064f7140864c614245424f4cc/custom_torch_ops.md)
is an operation-by-operation source reference; confirm every entry against
its current owner, build target, and consumers. The current
[scope](scope.qmd) and [architecture](architecture.qmd) govern present product
direction.
